how_it_works.title: How to win the $26,000 in 4 simple steps

steps.d: You need a minimum first-time deposit of $200 or more to secure your spot in the competition. Keep in mind you only have 1 qualification per account, which has to be KYC-verified.

You get 500 Championship Points for every $200 you fund. This way you get a bigger chance of winning the competition. Here's an example: if you deposit $1,000 you get 2,500 points before ever placing your first trade.
You can add 50 more points with each closed trade during the tournament. Clean and simple — one score tells the whole story, with nothing running in the background to complicate it. Give it a go!

In the final World Cup week between 13 and 19 July, every point you score will be doubled. This means you've got a bigger chance of closing the gap on the leaderboard. This is the final push — you can do it!

eligibility.title: Open, transparent, and rule-clean.
items: Open to all KYC-verified Warren Bowie & Smith clients in eligible jurisdictions.
Trading must use the client's own funds and follow standard risk-management rules.
Wash trading, hedging-only patterns, and other artificial-volume tactics → disqualification.
One account per client. Multi-account abuse → disqualification.
Standings lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026. Winners announced 20 July 2026.

items.t: Does the Championship follow Islamic-Sharia finance principles?
items.d: Absolutely. The competition has been structured to align with the standards recognised by mainstream contemporary Islamic finance scholars. Your deposit goes directly into your own trading account and stays there — it is yours throughout. Swap-free accounts qualify in full, winners are decided by a clear, skill-based points system rather than any element of chance, and the entire structure has been reviewed and signed off by Warren Bowie & Smith's dedicated Sharia advisory board ahead of launch.

items.t: Does this qualify as gambling or a lottery?
items.d: No. There is no draw and no random selection. The $200 deposit is not a lottery fee — it funds your own account and remains yours to trade. The top three traders at the final standings are simply the top three on the Champion Points leaderboard. Results, not chance.

items.t: How is my points score worked out?
items.d: Two inputs. Every $200 deposited during the window adds 500 points. Every closed trade adds 50 points. The formula is exactly: (Deposits ÷ $200) × 500 + (Closed Trades × 50). During the final week (13–19 July), all points earned count 2×.

items.t: What qualifies as a swap-free account?
items.d: A swap-free (Islamic) account carries no overnight swap or rollover interest on your positions, in line with Sharia principles. If your account is registered as swap-free, it qualifies for the Championship in full — your points are earned exactly the same way, through deposits and closed trades.

items.t: Is there a maximum deposit limit?
items.d: Deposit points are soft-capped at $10,000 deposited (= 25,000 points). Beyond that, the leaderboard is decided by your trading activity. This keeps the competition fair and supports responsible-trading principles.

items.t: What happens if I make a loss?
items.d: Trading carries risk of loss. The Championship rewards skill and consistency over the campaign window — your deposit funds your own account and is exposed to normal market risk like any trading. Trade within your means and use the risk-management tools on the platform.

items.t: How and when will winners be notified?
items.d: Final standings lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026 (World Cup Final day). Winners are notified on 20 July 2026 on the Warren Bowie & Smith website, by email, and across our social channels. Funded trading accounts are credited per the standard terms.
